title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of San Rafael in the Municipality of Guagua, Province of Pampanga
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of San Rafael in the Municipality of Guagua, Province of Pampanga

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1520_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Duck Island in the Municipality of Guagua, Province of Pampanga, is hereby constituted into a barrio of the said municipality, which shall be known as the barrio of San Rafael.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
